design_philosophy: Fusion of sterile high-tech biotech labs and deep organic jungle scales. Emotional tone is commanding, reassuring, and extremely advanced. Brings 'Exotic OS powered by Albedo' to life.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive scale. NEVER use Inter or Space Grotesk.

body.usage: Clear, readable text for paragraphs and interface labels.

mono.usage: For data points, dashboard metrics, and code-like elements

spacing_and_layout.marketing: Asymmetric Bento Grid (TETRIS mode) with gap-8 to gap-12. Generous p-12 to p-24 padding.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard: Control Room Grid (Dense) with gap-4 or gap-6. Strict hierarchy, heavy utilization of vertical space. Sharp edges.

surface_styles.marketing_cards: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), dark background (bg-black/40), and an electric 1px inner border (border-white/10) that highlights with primary color on hover.
surface_styles.dashboard_widgets: Flat dark backgrounds with sharp 1px border-white/5. On hover, slight lift and border transition to neon green or cyan.
surface_styles.tracing_beam: Use a subtle glowing border effect for primary CTA buttons or premium feature cards.

components_strategy.marketing: Custom HTML/Tailwind for Hero and feature bento grids. Do not use standard Shadcn cards. Build overlapping UI elements.
components_strategy.dashboard: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Charts using Recharts (Neon strokes, transparent backgrounds, no gridlines).
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky Crystal Glass header (z-50, backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-[#05080A]/70) with hard neon bottom border.

animations.hover: Transition border colors to neon glowing states. Example: hover:border-[#00FF66] hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,102,0.3)]
animations.page: Smooth entry fades and subtle parallax scrolling for organic textures.

hero_background.description: Close up of purple and green snake skin. Use as a textural background bleeding through a dark gradient for the hero section.

dashboard_texture.description: Abstract black and green tech lines. Use at low opacity (10%) behind the dashboard panels.

testimonials.description: Person portrait dark background neon light (Red/Blue)
Woman portrait dark background neon light (Blue/Orange)
Woman portrait dark background neon light (Red)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients has a text-shadow. Use #05080A tinted grey for backgrounds. Active elements must be highly visible.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='nav-login').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts via Google Fonts: Unbounded, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Marketing UI must not feel like a generic template. Use overlapping images, tight tracking on large headers (Unbounded text-5xl/6xl). Never use Inter for headings.
Dashboard UI must feel like a bio-tech control room. Dense, informative, with neon highlights strictly for data emphasis and active states.
Implement Recharts for temperature/humidity data. Customize chart strokes to glow using drop-shadow SVG filters.
Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the landing page layout; reserve customized Shadcn components for the App Dashboard.
Always apply 'data-testid' to CTA buttons, nav links, and dashboard interactive controls.
